hero.lead: Interactive courses in which every concept comes with a figure you can manipulate and the equivalent implementation in Python. Freely available.

one.title: Figures you can manipulate
one.body: Each concept is introduced through a figure that responds to interaction, so that geometric intuition precedes the algebraic formulation.

two.title: Implementation in Python
two.body: Each idea closes with the lines of NumPy that perform the equivalent operation, keeping the mathematics and the code together.

three.title: Freely available
three.body: The complete material is available without prior registration or access restrictions.
